title: Remotion Production Asset Kit
description: Original editable SVG visuals, generated textures, self-hosted OFL and Apache fonts, loopable music beds, and deterministic production sound effects.

assets.title: Film Grain
assets.usage: Screen or overlay blend at 6-14% opacity to kill digital flatness.

assets.usage: Subtle sensor noise for clean product and UI videos.

assets.title: Halftone Dots

assets.title: Scanlines
assets.usage: CRT and terminal looks; keep under 25% opacity so text stays sharp.

assets.title: Vignette
assets.usage: Full-frame darkening that pushes attention to the centre.

assets.title: Cool Light Leak
